case.summary: Transaction 3464869 for $599.94 online was flagged by the model score of 0.77 and matches the card_not_present_new_device pattern, with the device marked new to the account and the transaction amount four times the cardholder's median spend. The account has two prior confirmed-fraud cases on the same pattern, and eight structurally similar closed cases retrieved by shared device were all confirmed fraud with no false alarms. The assessment indicates fraud probability of 0.68 with pattern confidence at 0.57. The evidence is substantial but not conclusive on its own, and policy requires verification before a block when probability is below 0.70 and the case does not rest on multiple independent signals. No additional evidence was requested. I recommend escalation with monitoring and customer verification before declining, as the cardholder's legitimate activity across 79 transactions and multiple regions suggests this could be a high-value purchase rather than fraud, though the risk is clearly elevated at 0.68 probability.
